narrative.northStar: Choose music by its artwork, download once, and keep exploring.
narrative.overview: A Windows Go/Wails/React utility with artwork-led browsing and a persistent download strip. Cool-paper chrome and Prussian focus keep music visible while the automatic worker manages transfers.

rules.name: One worker
rules.body: Use the shared lease and persistent store; explicit pause survives additions.

donts: Do not require Start Queue for new downloads
Do not represent preview fixtures as user data
